description.zh: 结束时间。格式为 Unix 时间戳（UTC 时间），单位为秒。
description.en: The end time. The value is a UNIX timestamp (UTC). Unit: seconds.

description.zh:
WAF实例ID。

> 您可以通过调用[DescribeInstance](~~433756~~)接口查看当前WAF实例ID。
description.en:
Instance ID of the WAF instance.

> You can call the [DescribeInstance](~~433756~~) operation to query instance ID of the current WAF instance.
The number of entries per page in a paged query.

description.zh:
下一页查询凭证（**Token**），如果有下一页，则该字段有返回值。

>该参数只要返回值，则说明还有下一页。您可以将返回的**NextToken**作为请求参数再次获得下一页的数据，直到无返回值，表示获取到了所有的数据。
description.en:
The pagination token for the next page. If a next page exists, this field has a return value.

> If this parameter has a return value, a next page exists. You can use the returned **NextToken** as a request parameter to obtain the data on the next page. Repeat this process until no value is returned, which indicates that all data has been retrieved.
The statistical period type for billing.

description.zh:
WAF实例所属地域。取值：

- **cn-hangzhou**：表示中国内地。

- **ap-southeast-1**：表示非中国内地。
description.en:
The region where the WAF instance resides. Valid values:

- **cn-hangzhou**: the Chinese mainland.

- **ap-southeast-1**: outside the Chinese mainland.
The ID of the Alibaba Cloud resource group.

description.zh: 开始时间。格式为Unix时间戳（UTC时间），单位为秒。
description.en: The start time. The value is a UNIX timestamp (UTC). Unit: seconds.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun waf-openapi describe-postpay-bills --instance-id waf-cn-zz11sr50000 --start-time 1779120000 --end-time 1779195599 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --resource-manager-resource-group-id rg-acfm000q --max-results 24 --next-token caeba0bbb2be03f84eb48b699f000000 --period-type hour --api-version 2021-10-01 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun waf-openapi DescribePostpayBills --region cn-hangzhou --ResourceManagerResourceGroupId 'rg-acfm000q' --PeriodType hour --EndTime 1779195599 --NextToken caeba0bbb2be03f84eb48b699f000000 --InstanceId 'waf-cn-zz11sr50000' --MaxResults 24 --StartTime 1779120000 --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou'
